literal_meaning: আটকে যাওয়া কপালে (obstructed or stuck on the forehead)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কপালে আটক, কোনো কাজই সফল হয় না।
এই আটকপালী ছেলের জন্য সবাই দুঃখিত।
example_sentences_in_english: He has bad luck written on his forehead; nothing ever works out for him.
Everyone feels sorry for that ill-fated boy.
history: Rooted in Bengali cultural beliefs about destiny being inscribed on the forehead, influenced by Hindu astrology and karma concepts.
note: The idiom reflects traditional views on predestined misfortune, often used in rural or semi-urban contexts.
